records.title: Gramin Dak Sevak (India Post)
records.line: Village post office roles, filled on Class 10 marks with no written exam or interview.
records.cyc: Official notice dated 20 Aug 2026 (Schedule-II, July 2026): registration 31 Aug to 19 Sep, application and fee 2 to 21 Sep 2026, corrections 23 and 24 Sep. The next schedule has not been announced.
facts: 18 to 40 on the last date (43 OBC, 45 SC/ST)
Class 10 pass with passing marks in Maths and English; local language studied up to Class 10
records.note: Read from the Department of Posts notice itself. It gives no vacancy numbers; they are on the portal division by division. Selection is a merit list on Class 10 marks. The fee is ₹100, and women, SC/ST and disabled applicants pay nothing.

rules.title: Studied the local language up to Class 10
rules.detail: Kannada is the language listed for the Karnataka circle.

records.title: Railway Group D (Level 1)
records.line: Track, bridge and maintenance posts across zones. Selection is a computer test, a physical test, documents and a medical.
records.cyc: Last window 31 Jan to 2 Mar 2026. The next notice has not been announced.
records.note: Use the official site of the Railway Recruitment Board for your zone.

rules.title: Physical test and medical
rules.detail: You must clear both after the computer test.

records.title: SSC MTS (Multi Tasking Staff)
records.line: Office support posts in central government departments, chosen through a computer-based exam.
records.cyc: The 2025 exam was held in February 2026 (result notice 3 Aug 2026). The SSC notices I could read, up to 26 Oct 2026, do not announce an MTS 2026 exam. Check ssc.gov.in.
src: SSC result notice for MTS 2025, 3 Aug 2026
records.note: The source predicted dates and did not confirm them. The SSC notices I could read (to 26 Oct 2026) show the 2025 exam held in February 2026 and no MTS 2026 notice yet.

rules.title: Qualification

rules.title: For women
rules.detail: Anganwadi posts are normally filled by women.

ITI passed on or after 1 Jan 2022

rules.title: Needs an ITI certificate
rules.detail: You have not done an ITI yet. It is listed under Study further.

records.title: Karnataka 1st PUC (Science, Commerce, Arts)
records.line: Two years before degree courses, and the stream decides which entrance exams you can take later.
records.cyc: Registration opens on the first working day after SSLC results in May. Classes start in June.
facts: By each college, mostly on SSLC marks
Transfer certificate, marks card, birth certificate, photos, ID, residence proof
records.note: The source disagreed with itself on online versus offline forms. Confirm with the college.

records.title: Diploma (polytechnic) after Class 10
records.line: A technical diploma that leads to jobs, and to the second year of an engineering degree through lateral entry.
records.cyc: Applications were in the second to third week of May in the cycle I read, then a merit list from SSLC marks.
facts: Merit from SSLC marks and category
Diploma holders can enter 2nd-year engineering through DCET
records.note: Undated source. I could not confirm whether an entrance test applies. The DCET detail comes from a separate Careers360 page.

records.title: ITI trade course
records.line: Hands-on trade training. An ITI certificate opens apprenticeships such as BEL and counts for Railway Group D.
records.cyc: I have not yet found Karnataka ITI admission dates or seat rules.
facts: Apprenticeships, Railway Group D, 2nd-year diploma entry
BEL notice, Railway Group D notice, CollegeSimplified
records.note: Not researched in depth. Check admission rules and dates with the Karnataka training department.

records.title: KCET 2027
records.line: Karnataka entrance for engineering, agriculture, pharmacy and allied seats. Taken after 2nd PUC.
records.cyc: Estimated from 2026: registration mid-Jan to late Feb, exam in April, results in early June. The 2027 dates apply to students finishing 2nd PUC now.
facts: Physics, Chemistry, Maths (engineering) or Biology (agriculture, pharmacy, nursing)
7 years of study in Karnataka for government quota
records.note: Dates are estimates; the authority has not announced them.

rules.title: Physics and Chemistry with Maths or Biology

records.title: NEET UG 2027

records.cyc: Tentatively 2 May 2027. Registration dates are not announced.
records.note: Date is a projection, not an NTA notice.

records.title: CUET UG 2027
records.line: Entrance for central university degree seats. Taken after 2nd PUC.
records.cyc: Expected: registration around January 2027, exam mid to late May.
records.note: Every 2027 date on the source is an estimate.

records.title: JEE Main 2027
